737:t_117:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ドロシー#bigo$$ is right. I live as my heart leads me.」

737:t_117:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Prepare yourselves, $$御使い$$s! I'll fight you for the future we will live in, rather than for $$パラダイムシティ$$'s past!!」

737:t_118:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「The way these guys stink...! They're the lowest, worst scum by far, compared to every villain so far!」

737:t_118:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I'd expect no less from a reincarnated winged dog! But you have no tact!」

737:t_118:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is understandable. We imprisoned his masters, the $$天翅$$s, between dimensions 120 million years ago.」

737:t_118:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「And the $$堕天翅$$s swore revenge on the $$天翅$$s...!」

737:t_118:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「That anger and hatred flowed from $$頭翅#pilot$$ into $$ミカゲ$$!」

737:t_118:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then let's do it! We'll strike them with the anguish of the $$堕天翅$$s, the humans... everyone they made suffer!」

737:t_118:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「A winged dog couldn't possibly do that!」

737:t_118:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm not the winged dog $$ポロン$$! I've got the name $$アポロ$$, given to me by a precious friend!」

737:t_118:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Here we come, $$御使い$$s! We'll defeat you here for the sake of every life!!」

737:t_119:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「They're strong...! They're on a different level from every enemy we've fought!」

737:t_119:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Of course! There are two $$御使い$$s aboard this $$プロディキウム$$!」

737:t_119:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Don't get cocky just because you defeated $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! He grew corrupt over those 12,000 years!」

737:t_119:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If you have the power of two, I'll gather the power of all the $$エレメント$$s and fight!」

737:t_119:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And the love $$ミコノ$$ and I share won't lose to your 120 million years!」

737:t_119:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do not speak of eternity, mere human!」

737:t_119:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Shut up! Whatever you say, the love $$ミコノ$$ and I share will transcend eternity!!」

737:t_120:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Do you want to destroy the world again?」

737:t_120:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Reflect on your own actions. This time you will destroy not just one world, but every universe.」

737:t_120:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「If you understand, lay down your weapons. And bow your head.」

737:t_120:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't know... what's right and what's wrong... But I do know this...」

737:t_120:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「You're the enemies of everyone alive! That's why I'll... fight!」

737:t_121:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「These guys aren't ordinary villains!」

737:t_121:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You seem to understand a few things, at least.」

737:t_121:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But thoughtlessly judging anyone who opposes you to be evil is still foolish.」

737:t_121:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That arrogant attitude, looking down on us completely, pisses me off far more than any of the others!」

737:t_121:4.en:
$$パーラ$$
「$$ガロード$$ is right! You're the lowest, worst scum we've ever met!」

737:t_121:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「How foolish. You know nothing of proper conduct and merely lash out with primitive emotions.」

737:t_121:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the hell are you talking about!? What's wise about deciding we're evil just because we won't obey you!?」

737:t_121:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We're going to live! Whatever you say, $$ティファ$$ and I have decided to move toward the future!!」

737:t_122:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Why didn't you use that power for the universe!? Why can't you see that nothing comes from the powerful using it to rule others!?」

737:t_122:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「What!? You're making it sound like what we've done is bad!」

737:t_122:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Leave him, $$テンプティ$$. Explaining our ideals to such inferior creatures is pointless.」

737:t_122:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「It's true that humanity is immature compared to you...」

737:t_122:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But we have a future ahead! And you're trying to take that future away!」

737:t_122:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Be silent! That is our mission!」

737:t_122:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I... won't accept that! I'll fight people who say things like that!!」

737:t_123:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「These are the ones blocking humanity's future...! Our true enemies!」

737:t_123:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Too bad, $$ニュータイプ$$! You finally awakened, but you fail!」

737:t_123:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We shall bury you before you follow a distorted path of evolution! That is the duty of the universe's administrators!」

737:t_123:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't let you do as you please with my... our lives and future!」

737:t_123:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If I am humanity's forerunner, my duty is to open a path to the future!」

737:t_123:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You would struggle with your immature power!?」

737:t_123:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's a $$ニュータイプ$$'s mission...! That's my power, guided by $$ガンダム$$!!」

737:t_124:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「This kid has real potential, doesn't he?」

737:t_124:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「What a shame. Raised under our supervision, he might have walked the path to $$シンカ$$.」

737:t_124:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't talk about people like they're pets! My life belongs to me!」

737:t_124:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are the $$御使い$$s. We guide all life in the universe in the proper direction.」

737:t_124:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can't forgive that arrogance!」

737:t_124:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You steal the lives that should fill the universe! You must not be allowed to exist!!」

737:t_124:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll defeat that arrogance! That is our final battle!!」

737:t_125:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're amazing. You awakened through $$ガンダム$$'s power.」

737:t_125:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You are truly the very sin produced by the civilization of fire.」

737:t_125:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're talking about the $$ユニコーン$$ drawing out my power...!」

737:t_125:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But in the end, you chose not to abandon your body. That's humanity's limit.」

737:t_125:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「If you had transcended matter then, you could have taken your first step toward $$シンカ$$.」

737:t_125:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't regret my choice! I still have things to do with this body!」

737:t_125:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll keep my promise to $$オードリー$$! To do that, I'll defeat you and return to Earth!」

737:t_125:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll show my own potential! With that power, I'll open a path to the future!!」

737:t_126:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「To protect this universe, to open a path to the future...! I'll strike you down here!」

737:t_126:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's so stupid! To us, your power is barely any different from an ordinary human's!」

737:t_126:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You overestimated your own power! That is your sin!」

737:t_126:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「I don't think I can beat you with an $$イノベイター$$'s power alone...!」

737:t_126:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「What else have you got!?」

737:t_126:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm a $$ガンダムマイスター$$ of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$... of $c!」

737:t_126:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm not alone! With all our power, we'll defeat you and open a path to the universe's future!!」

737:t_127:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Now I understand everything! Beings like you bring war into this universe!」

737:t_127:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Are you angry that $$クロノ$$ persecuted people in space?」

737:t_127:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That was necessary to oversee evolution. A mere individual like you would not understand.」

737:t_127:3.en:
$$シン$$
「I won't forgive the wars that took those ordinary people's lives!」
